# cgf-converter (KCD2-Convertor.exe)

ModMaster ships this program so game models open in Blender and in the 3D preview without extra installs.
It runs as a separate program; ModMaster only calls it.

- Project: Cryengine Converter by Markemp (Heffay Presents) and contributors
- Source: https://github.com/Markemp/Cryengine-Converter
- Build in this folder: commit 47ef99400bfcc4fe9a3c62713dcbc4640a0c084d
  (https://github.com/Markemp/Cryengine-Converter/tree/47ef99400bfcc4fe9a3c62713dcbc4640a0c084d),
  the same build the KCD2 Blender Toolkit by Lune ships as KCD2-Convertor.exe
- SHA-256: 51a18ca5e2cdb82e464bbccc8acee6a916f86fb2eb1afee8c0b164635db85bbe
- License: GNU General Public License v2.0, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

The .exe is not kept in git. Place KCD2-Convertor.exe here before running tools/build_release.py.
